title: Greer's Joe Rogan episode removed for Spotify

tellings.quote: Well, he in order to get his money from Spotify, they had to take it out.

plain: An episode of Joe Rogan's very popular podcast featuring Steven Greer was taken down around 2020, because Rogan had to remove it to get his money from Spotify, the streaming company that had signed his show. Greer, a researcher and campaigner on UFOs who was the guest on that episode, tells Michels this himself without naming a source. In his telling, it shows his message being pushed off the big platforms.
